name: anchor-alarm-functions
description: Cloud Functions for Anchor Alarm remote monitoring: alarm push notifications and lost-contact detection.

scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@15 emulators:exec --config ../firebase.json --project demo-anchor-alarm --only auth,firestore,functions "vitest run test/emulator"
scripts.serve: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@15 emulators:start --config ../firebase.json --project demo-anchor-alarm
